<entry id="U00355">
<head-word>שְׁוַור</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, 
<italic>Pa.</italic> שַׁוַּור, שַׁוַּר </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to stride, leap, run, hasten</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Y. Ex. XVII, 8 (ed. Vien. ושווד, corr. acc.). Ib. XXXII, 19. Targ. Cant. II, 8. Targ. Job XXXVII, 1 Var. Targ. Am. III, 5 ed. Lag. (oth. ed. יִסַּק); a. fr.—B. Mets. 84
<sup>a</sup> וש' לירדנא וכ' he ran into the Jordan after him. B. Bath. 73
<sup>b</sup> ושַׁוַּאר מהאי וכ' (Ms. H. ושוור) and jumped from one mule’s back to the other. Ib. 96
<sup>b</sup> חמרא … שואר wine travels on its owner’s shoulder, i.e. if wine turns sour, it is the purchaser’s bad luck, and the seller is not responsible; oth. opin. (Tosaf.) wine turns sour by transport. Ber. 54
<sup>b</sup> ש' עשר אמין he (Moses) jumped ten cubits high. Sabb. 110
<sup>a</sup> לִישַׁוַּאר נגרא (Ar. לשוור) let him jump over a ditch. Pes. 113
<sup>a</sup> לא תְשַׁוַּור וכ', v. נִיגְרָא; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to cause to jump</italic> &c. Targ. Ps. XXIX, 6 (Ms. טפז').</definition>
<notes>).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition> (cmp. meanings of קפץ) 
<italic>to close up</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ib. CVII, 42 (Ms. שרור', corr. acc.; h. text קפצה).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="U00361">
<head-word>שׁוּחַ</head-word>
<hw-number>I</hw-number>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.)
<italic>to bend, sink</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ḥull. 27
<sup>a</sup> ממקום ששָׁח וכ', v. חָטָא I. Ib. שח … והוא שח ועומד הוא ‘where it bends’ implies (that the limb which is to be cut) must be erect (when in its natural condition), but this (the tail) is always hanging down. Y. Taan. II, 65
<sup>c</sup> top צריך לָשׁוּחַ בכולן (or לָשׁוֹחַ fr. שחח) he must bend down with all of them (the eighteen vertebræ). Ber. 34
<sup>a</sup>, v. שָׁחָה. Ab. V, 21 בן תשעים לָשׁוּחַ at ninety years (is the time) for being bent (perh. meant as noun לַשּׁוּחַ). Midr. Till. to Ps. XLVIII לבו שח עליו his heart within him is bent (in grief over his sin); Yalk. ib. 755 סח (corr. acc.); a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpol.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִשְׁתּוֹחֵחַ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be bent down, depressed</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Midr. Till. to Ps. XLII אני מתקנאה ומִשְׁתּוֹחַחַת וכ' I am jealous and desperate, when I see the happiness of the nations &c.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<italic>bribe, bribery</italic>. Midr. Till. to Ps. XVII, 2 כתבת בתורה … ליקח ש' … אבל אתה שאתה נוטל ש' מן הרשעים וכ' thou hast written in the Law (Ex. XXIII, 8), ‘thou shalt take no bribe’, and they (men) are afraid to take presents and judge me, but thou who acceptest means of conciliation from sinners, such as repentance, good deeds, and prayer: let thy judgment go forth from before thee. Keth. 105
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to Ex. l. c.) אינו … ש' ממון אלא אפי' ש' דברים וכ' not only a bribe in the shape of money, but even a bribe in acts (service) is forbidden. Ib.
<sup>a</sup> כמה סמויות … מקבלי ש', v. סָמָה. Ib.
<sup>b</sup> ש̇וח̇ד̇ ש̇הוא ח̇ד̇ (Ar. אח̇ד̇) why is it called 
<italic>shoḥad?</italic> Because it is one (the recipient and the giver are made like one person); a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="U00372">
<head-word>שׁוּט</head-word>
<hw-number>I</hw-number>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) [
<italic>to swing, be light, move to and fro;</italic> v. 
<xref rid="U00374">שׁוֹט II</xref>,] 
<italic>to roam, fly, float, swim</italic>.</definition>
<notes> M. Kat. 14
<sup>a</sup> לָשׁוּט if he goes abroad to roam (for mere pleasure), opp. למזונות for support, להרויחא for profit in business. B. Bath. 15
<sup>b</sup> (Satan says) שַׁטְתִּי בכל וכ' I roamed all over the world, but have found none so faithful as &c. Bets. V, 2 (36
<sup>b</sup>) לא שָׁטִין על פני המים you must not float on the water (swim on the Sabbath). Y. Shek. VI, 50
<sup>a</sup> top (ref. to Ez. XLVII, 5) כי גאו המים מי שחו מִלָּשׁוּט (omit מהו מי שחו, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l., p. 55) the waters were risen … too high for swimming; a. e.—[Y. B. Mets. VIII, end, 11
<sup>d</sup> בששטן, read: בששטפן, v. שָׁטַף.]</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pol.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>שׁוֹטֵט</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes> same. Yalk. Gen. 101 עד שהיתה קומתו מְשׁוֹטֶטֶת בדמעות until his body swam in tears.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הֵשִׁיט</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to cause to swim, teach swimming</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Kidd. 30
<sup>b</sup> אף לַהֲשִׁיטוֹ בנהר a father is also bound to have his son taught swimming; Tosef. ib. I, 11; Koh. R. to IX, 9 להושיטו (corr. acc.).</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<sup>b</sup> (transl. Deut. I, 44) כמא דנתזין דבריאתא ושייטן ברומי וכ' as bees rush forth and fly about on the heights of the world, and bring honey from the herbs of the mountains; a. e.</notes></sense></senses>

<sense>

Gen. 137 we are the majority עמנו לע"א (עצמיכם) מפני מה אינכם מַשְׁוִים why do you not accommodate yourselves to us with regard to idolatry? <italic>to arrange;</italic> cmp. עָרַךְ, סָדַר,]

<sup>a</sup>, v. שְׁוִי. Macc. 3
<sup>a</sup> כיצד שמין how do we assess (the fine)? Y. Kidd. I, 60
<sup>d</sup> bot. (expl. נעשח דמים באחר, Mish. 6) דבר שהוא צריך לָשׁוּם that which has to be prized (which is not itself a standard value). B. Mets. IX, 3 המקבל … שמין אותה וכ' if one rents a field on shares and lets it lie waste, we estimate how much it ought to yield &c. Tosef. ib. IX, 9 השָׁם, v. שׁוּם II; a. v. fr.—M. Kat. 5
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to וְשָׂם, Ps. L, 23) כל השָׁם אורחותיו וכ' he who calculates his ways (weighs the consequences of his doings) will be allowed to see the salvation of the Lord (in the hereafter); אל תקרי וְשָׂם אלא וְשָׁם וכ' read not 
<italic>v’sam</italic> but 
<italic>v’sham</italic> &c.; Sot. 5
<sup>b</sup>; Yalk. Ps. 763; (Lev. R. s. 9 דשָׁיֵים אורחיה).—Part. pass. שׁוּם; f. שׁוּמָה; pl. שׁוּמִים; שׁוּמוֹת. Tosef. B. Kam. X, 1 רואין אוֹתן כאילו הן ש' אצל אחרים we consider them (the forcibly taken animals) as if they had been valued (sold for their value) with others, i.e. the robber pays the value of the animals as it was at the time of the robbery; B. Kam. 95
<sup>a</sup> כאילו היא שומה אצלו בכסף as if the animal had been sold at its value to him (the robber), for cash; ib.
<sup>b</sup> שומא (Chald. form); ib. רואין … ש' אצלו למחצה וכ' we consider it, as if it had been valued &c., for the purpose of establishing the additional amount which he has to pay for the increase in value, which is either one half, or one third, or one fourth (according to local usage). Arakh. 21
<sup>b</sup> וכך היא שומה וכ' Rashi (ed. שומא) and so much has it been appraised; whosoever wishes to buy &c.; a. e.</notes></sense></senses>

<entry id="U00437">
<head-word>שׁוּם</head-word>

<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (preced.) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>valuation, estimate</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Kam. I, 3 ש' כסף, v. שָׁוֶה. Tosef. B. Mets. IX, 9 השם קמתו … את שׁוּמוֹ וכ' if one prizes (and buys) his neighbor’s standing corn as ten Cors of wheat, and it yields less or more, the seller has to deliver the estimated quantity (no more nor less); Rabbi Judah says, עשה בפחות נותן לו את שומו וכ' if it yielded less, he has to deliver the estimated quantity, if more, he has to deliver whatever it yielded; a. fr.—Esp. 
<italic>the description and valuation of seized property</italic> and its advertisement for public sale. Arakh. VI, 1 ש' היתומים שלשים יום the advertisement of orphans’ property must be made thirty days in succession (before the sale); Tosef. ib. IV, 1. Tosef. Keth. XI, 2; B. Bath. 107
<sup>a</sup> שלשה שירדו לש' וכ' if of three experts called to appraise seized property, one says, it is worth a Maneh &c.; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>appraised goods brought into marriage by the wife</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Keth. VI, 3 (66
<sup>a</sup>) פסקה … וכנגד הש' וכ' if she promises to bring him a thousand Denars, he must obligate himself for fifteen Maneh (as her jointure); but for appraised goods brought to him, he obligates himself for one fifth less than the appraised value. Ib. ש' במנה ושוה מנה וכ' (Y. ed. ש' מנה) if the agreement reads, ‘the goods are charged to the husband for one Maneh and worth a Maneh’, he can claim only one Maneh’s worth of goods; ש' במנה היא וכ' but if it reads merely, ‘the goods are charged for one Maneh’, she must bring in the value of thirty-one Selaim and one Denar (Tosaf.; differ. in Rashi). Tosef. ib. VI, 6 מקום … מן הש' וכ' where the usage is not to charge the husband less than the appraised value &c.; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition> (Chaldaism) 
<italic>name, title;</italic> לְשׁוּם 
<italic>in the name of, for the sake of, for the purpose of, in the capacity of</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gitt. IV, 4 עבד … אם לש' עבד וכ' if a slave was taken captive, and some one redeemed him: if he redeemed him as a slave, he may be held as a slave (of his redeemer), if as a freed man &c. Ib. III, 1 כל גט שנכתב שלא לש' אשה a letter of divorce not written with the intention to be used for a special woman. Ib. VIII, 5 כתב לש' מלכות אחרת if a letter of divorce is dated in the name of a strange government; (Bab. ed. 79
<sup>b</sup> שאינה הוגנת, v. הוּגָּן). Yeb. 24
<sup>b</sup> איש שנתגייר לש' אשה a man that embraced the Jewish religion for the sake of a woman; לש' שולחן מלכים for the sake of the royal table (v. שׁוּלְחָן); לש' עבדי שלמה for the sake of being one of Solomon’s servants; a. v. fr.—
<pgbrk id="pg1536" />[Ib. 47
<sup>b</sup> לשֵׁם שפחות in her capacity as a slave; לשם שחרור with the purpose of making her a freed woman; a. fr.]—מִשּׁוּם a) 
<italic>in the name of</italic>. Maas. Sh. III, 6 ר"ש … מש' ר' יוסי R. S. ben J. says in behalf of R. José (quoting R. J. as author). Eduy. VIII, 5; a. v. fr.—b) 
<italic>because of, as coming under the category of; for the sake of</italic> (
<italic>preventing</italic>). Bets. 2
<sup>b</sup>, a. fr. גזדה מש', v. גְּזֵרָה. Sabb. 17
<sup>b</sup> מש' שמנן, v. גָּזַר. Ab. Zar. 26
<sup>a</sup>, a. fr. מש' איבה, v. אֵיבָה. Sabb. 70
<sup>b</sup> כלום פריש … מש' מלאכות … מש' שבת does any one abstain from doing a thing on the Sabbath for any reason but because of the prohibition of labors, and does one abstain from any labor for any reason, but because of the Sabbath? Ib. 73
<sup>b</sup> חייב מש' נוטע is guilty, because the act comes under the category of planting. Kil. I, 9 אינו חושש לא מש' כלאים וכ' he need not hesitate to use it either on the ground of forbidden mixture, or on the ground of the Sabbatical year (in which planting is forbidden), or because it is subject to tithes. Ib. IX, 8 אין אפור מש' וכ' nothing is forbidden as mixture of wool and linen unless it is spun &c.; a. v. fr.—Ber. 5
<sup>b</sup> מש' תורה דלא וכ' (dost thou weep) on account of the Law, that thou hast not attained much?; או מש' מזוני or on account of thy support (that thou art poor)?—משום שֶׁ־, (Chald.) מש' דְּ־; על שום שֶׁ־, (Chald.) על ש' ד־ 
<italic>because</italic>. Pes. X, 5 פסח על ש' שפסח וכ' the Passover sacrifice is eaten, because the Lord passed over &c. Y. Naz. II, beg. 51
<sup>d</sup> מש' שהוציא וכ' because he uttered the word 
<italic>nazir</italic>. Keth. 63
<sup>b</sup> מש' דרב זביד וכ' because Rab Zebid is a great man &c.; a. v. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<sense>

<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to smooth, rub, polish, sharpen; to smear over, plaster</italic>.</definition>

<sup>b</sup>; Ned. 56
<sup>b</sup> משיְשַׁפֵּם (Rashi משישופם). Kel. l. c. גמר שלא לָשׁוּף if he decided not to smooth them. Y. Ber. III, 5
<sup>d</sup> bot. לאיזה דבר הוא שָׁפָהּ for what purpose should he polish it? Ḥull. 25
<sup>a</sup>, sq.; Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. II, 10. Tosef. Toh. VI, 12 ושָׁפָה את רוקו and she rubbed his spittle off (with her foot); שָׁפוֹת וכ' (להיות) … שכן for it is the habit of Israelitish women during menstruation to rub off &c. Y. Sabb. VII, 10
<sup>b</sup> top רוקק ושָׁף he spits on the stone pavement and rubs it out (with his foot). M. Kat. I, 10 שָׁפִין את הסדקין you may plaster over the rifts in the roof (during the festive week). Sabb. XX, 3 ולא שפין אותן nor must you rub them (with the hand to cleanse them). Eduy. I, 8 שורין ושפין וכ' you must observe levitical cleanness when you soak them and rub (your body) with them. Sabb. 75
<sup>b</sup> השף בין העמודים he who rubs (smooths skins) between columns; Y. ib. VII, 10
<sup>c</sup> bot. השף את העור על גבי העמוד. Kel. XXX, 1 שָׁפָן בשופין files them with a file. Pes. II, 7 אבל שָׁפָה היא וכ' but she may rub (the bran) dry over her body (to soften her skin); a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to run smoothly, glide</italic>.</definition>
<notes>. Gen. R. s. 6; Midr. Sam. ch. IX.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition> (b. h.) 
<italic>to grind, crush, stamp</italic>.</definition>

IV, 7 וישראל … ואתם באים לָשׁוּף אותה מן העקב and the Israelites say to them (the gentiles asking for a share in the hereafter), in how many troubles … we surrendered our lives for the sanctification of the Lord, and you want to stamp it (all this good) out of your heels (out of the ground)?; (ed. Bub. אותם על העקב, corr. acc.); Yalk. ib. 627 לשוף עצמיכם מן העקב (corr. acc.).—[Midr. Till. to Ps. XCII וישופני עקב, v. שׁוּף I.]</notes></sense></senses>

<sup>b</sup> נוהג כש' he conducts himself properly. Snh. 105
<sup>b</sup> אהבה מבטלת ש' של גדולה love disregards the rule of dignified conduct (causes men to do things ordinarily left to servants); שנאה מבטלת ש' וכ' so does hatred disregard &c.; Gen. R. s. 55 מקלקלת את הש'; a. fr.—שׁוּרַת הדין the line of justice,

<italic>;</italic> לפנים מש' הדין inside the line of justice,

<plural-form>Pl. שׁוּרוֹת</plural-form>. Y. Ber. IV, 7

<sup>c</sup> bot. אב̇ … עושין לו ש' וכ' when the president enters (college), they must form lines for him, and he passes those which he chooses; (Hor. 13
<sup>b</sup> שורה אחת מכאן וכ' one line on each side). Mekh. B’shall., ʿĂmal., s. 1 העומדים בש' המלחמה who stand in the battle lines; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>
